rationale: Submit a complete bounded safety check with a necessary-leader-support case and a permitted follower-majority case, both produced through actual public API histories.

candidate.rationale: Test an explicit persistence-before-counting responsibility without assuming local leader persistence is always necessary.

question.question: Can leader commitment of a current-term proposal advance before the replicas whose storage workers have completed matching appends constitute the active voting majority, when the leader append worker is finitely delayed?
question.importance: Counting an undurable replica toward a required majority can expose committed data to loss after failures. The proposed check observes only the library commitment boundary and storage completion ordering, not crash-induced data loss or client completion.
participants: Serialized RawNode callers and FIFO local append/apply workers
contexts: AsyncStorageWrites with fixed simple voter membership
Leader append worker held while remote append workers and messages run, then released
event_paths: RawNode.Propose -> appendEntry -> deferred self MsgAppResp / remote MsgApp -> follower append -> storage response -> leader Match -> majority -> maybeCommit

Async Ready envelopes defer these responses until local append completion.
maybeCommit requires a current-term entry and tracker aggregates only active voters.
A follower majority without the leader is legitimate, so local persistence is not an unconditional prerequisite.
unknowns: Whether actual self and remote producers, asynchronous Ready collection and commitment consumer preserve the storage-qualified quorum relation in a complete finite execution with held leader writes.
question.trigger_rationale: The source separates sending replication from publishing support, and initializes self Match during role transitions. A real elected leader and proposal with delayed local appends tests this distinction at the commit endpoint. Two voters make the leader necessary; three voters supply a permitted follower-majority control.

obligation.description: Under a fixed simple voter configuration and compliant asynchronous storage workers, a leader may count replicas toward commitment of a current-term entry only after matching log entries have completed storage writes on those replicas; an advanced committed prefix must therefore be backed by a voting majority of such replicas.

scope.description: Storage-qualified leader commitment of ordinary current-term entries in fixed simple configurations under asynchronous Ready processing.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine messages and honest FIFO storage workers.
No membership changes during the selected proposal interval.
MemoryStorage is the storage-completion model; completed writes are not lost during these executions.
excluded: Physical disk durability and crash recovery
Global consensus safety or client linearizability conclusions

grounding.derivation: The implementation explicitly requires entries to be persisted before being counted toward commitment (durability-expectation). The async contract permits outgoing replication before local writes but requires storage-worker responses after ordered durable completion. Under a fixed simple voting configuration, commitment may use any majority of persisted matching replicas; it does not require the leader itself to have persisted when other replicas form a majority. This requirement is independent of the observed committed value and of a blanket expectation that delayed local writes block every commit.
grounding.applicability: Non-Byzantine peers; stable fixed simple voter membership; async storage mode; current-term ordinary proposal; honest ordered storage workers, no crashes or data corruption. MemoryStorage represents successfully completed storage writes at the library boundary; no physical disk durability is measured.
alternatives: A three-voter leader may legally commit using both followers while its own append worker is delayed.

associations.rationale: This consumer is the commitment endpoint for queued storage-qualified append support.

bindings.description: Leader combines current term with tracker quorum index before raftLog commitment.
